Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2203.13270v2. Local weak-source extension and smoothness/accuracy assumptions establish weak-supervision workflow. The proof and unread algorithm appendices are not promoted as independently verified. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The label model assumes conditionally independent weak sources for simplicity, and source extension can lose accuracy when radius is too large or embeddings lack smoothness; embedding-smoothness guarantees therefore do not apply without their stated assumptions.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Liger combines weak-source votes with fixed foundation-model embeddings to estimate local source accuracies and extend votes to nearby abstaining points; threshold radii and local smoothness control the extension tradeoff.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Evaluation used Spam, Weather, Spouse and three video tasks (Commercial, Tennis, Basketball), with unlabeled train data, smaller hand-labeled development sets and held-out tests; GPT-3 Ada supplied text embeddings and CLIP supplied video-frame embeddings.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Across the six tasks, the authors report that Liger improved coverage by 33.2 percentage points on average versus the vanilla weak-supervision label model; hand-labeled development data were used for hyperparameter tuning.
